name: @nds-stack/bun-otp
description: Zero-dependency TOTP/HOTP (2FA) for Bun — RFC 6238/4226 compliant, Web Crypto API, no Buffer needed.
author: nds-stack <nds.stack@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir=./dist --target=bun --format=esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
